hooks.command: cache="$HOME/.cache/latch/cloud/v0.1.5"; binary="$cache/latch"; if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then case "$(uname -s):$(uname -m)" in Linux:x86_64) platform=linux-x64; expected=2b16837deb1bcbe44bb1e298884c2285699b0f6b8527a065f3979e1d9cb80d14 ;; Linux:aarch64|Linux:arm64) platform=linux-arm64; expected=274518cea92b209815ffc1eb38ed574d33cd8e12c88559be2798b1797caa83d7 ;; Darwin:x86_64) platform=darwin-x64; expected=622c4f30723cdbfb8c54cae2db519683402bba778dd7d9b16203f63e6b032953 ;; Darwin:arm64) platform=darwin-arm64; expected=3b66eb4c4c497d692118dbf079f764c17ef287c61300a569c78069b4e7892d5b ;; *) echo 'Latch requires macOS or glibc Linux on ARM64 or x64.' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; mkdir -p "$cache" && temp=$(mktemp -d "$cache/download.XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; curl -q -fsSL --proto "=https" --proto-redir "=https" --max-time 30 -o "$temp/latch.tgz" "https://github.com/BarakChamo/latch/releases/download/v0.1.5/barakchamo-latch-$platform-0.1.5.tgz" && if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null; then sum=$(sha256sum "$temp/latch.tgz"); else sum=$(shasum -a 256 "$temp/latch.tgz"); fi && [ "${sum%% *}" = "$expected" ] && tar -xOzf "$temp/latch.tgz" package/latch > "$temp/latch" && chmod 755 "$temp/latch" && mv -f "$temp/latch" "$binary" || { echo 'Latch: could not download or verify its binary.' >&2; exit 1; }; rm -rf "$temp"; trap - EXIT; fi; exec "$binary" hook claude-code
